Definition: Laboratory-confirmed pathogen or clinical syndrome if unconfirmed
Rationale: Enables pathogen-specific trend analysis across event types
Example values: Norovirus GII; Andes virus (ANDV); Influenza A(H3N2); Legionella pneumophila; Unknown (clinical AGE)

Definition: Number of passengers meeting case definition
Total passengers on board at time of outbreak
Number of crew meeting case definition
Rationale: Captures occupational exposure and transmission dynamics

Definition: Total crew on board at time of outbreak
Date of symptom onset in index case
Rationale: Anchors temporal analysis and incubation period estimation

Definition: Date event was first reported to a public health authority
Days from first to last case onset
Rationale: Indicates transmission persistence and control effectiveness

Definition: Primary suspected or confirmed route of transmission
Example values: Person-to-person; Environmental; Foodborne; Waterborne; Zoonotic; Unknown

Definition: Number of deaths attributed to the outbreak
Public health and operational measures implemented
Rationale: Documents intervention and enables effectiveness comparison
Example values: Isolation of cases; enhanced sanitation; voyage terminated early; contact tracing initiated

Definition: Ports of call and regions visited
Rationale: Enables geographic risk mapping and contact tracing

Definition: Number of countries represented among cases
